install_dir.description: Directory where chkrootkit binaries are installed.

check_interval_days.description: Number of days between automatic scans (0 disables automatic runs).

quiet_mode.description: If true, suppress normal output when no problems are detected.

enable_checks.description: List of individual checks to enable or disable. Each item specifies a check name and whether it's enabled.

enabled.description: Whether the check should be run

use_selective_checking.description: If true, only run checks explicitly listed in enable_checks. Otherwise, run all default checks except those explicitly disabled.

debug_mode.description: If true, enable verbose debug output.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for scan results. If empty, logging is disabled.

mail_to.description: Email addresses to send scan results to (comma-separated in config).

mail_subject.description: Subject line for email notifications. Leave empty to use default.

email_threshold.description: Minimum 'alert level' required to trigger email. 0 = always email, 1 = email only if potential problems found, 2+ = stricter thresholds.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed directly to chkrootkit.

hostname.description: System hostname — used in default mail subject.
